chunks.text: No complaints with Robinhood over the years. Great platform, UI, UX, and clear descriptions of option strategies. However, with the recent push for prediction markets they have placed that section above the cash and investment areas on the "investments" tab. I hope this is only an A/B test because right now I loathe that UI placement decision. Update: They responded promptly and reverted the UI change on my app but my buying power is empty when it should show a value.

App is scummy. They run "predictions" markets now which is literally just gambling. They push robinhood gold on me even though I already did the trial. Now they are trying to get people to sign up for Robinhood gold and get "a portion of $1 million" but you have to keep all money on Robinhood for 1 year. Let's see that's $60 for one year of Gold so only 16,700 people can sign up before the payout is smaller than this cost. Keep in mind Robinhood claims to have 26 MILLION accounts.

I really wish they would let us hide anything related to prediction markets and crypto. Not that I don't invest in crypto I just prefer publicly traded. The prediction markets though really need to go. I come to invest not gamble. I wish they would road map for investors also, the last summit they had was like. "hey gamblers come see what we are up to!" Robinhood needs a self managed robo advisory service. or wide assortment of direct indexing options.
It's straightfoward enough to use but I can't help noticing that a feature like "prediction markets" appears when I can't even participate in it in my "region" and there's no option to hide it

The recent change that combines Prediction Markets with my investment performance is a major step backward. A small prediction market loss now makes my stock portfolio look like it performed worse, even though my investments are doing fine. Prediction markets are fundamentally different from investing and should have separate performance tracking, or at least a toggle to exclude them from the main portfolio graph. Please reverse this change.
Love the platform, but 4 stars. because I just don't like how they're trying to push sports betting on me just because I trade options, and I don't see a way to disable it.

use to be a good platform. Im probably pulling my account and moving it elsewhere though. They now push the "prediction market" to the top and theres no way to turn it off which is basically begging its users to go gamble.
new update to prediction markets sucks. let users sort by events like prior.

I agree with the review left by another Coinbase account holder it really gets on my last nerve too. Really after two minutes it should disappear but it stays put for the duration of my time on the app and it’s ridiculous really you think we don’t know that our money is at risk we’re all adults here well we should be and it just gets in the way. Please do something about it as soon as possible. What  really irritates me about it is the fact that I’ve taken the 2 minute test /quiz and passed so for me it should definitely not be there but it remains there like a title, please 🙏 remove it maybe put it on the log in screen so once we’ve logged in it goes. Or add a x to close it at least
app spams me with notifications for sports betting. sports betting shouldn't be in an investment app ever.
Not a fan of the recent move to "predictions markets" (gambling). App used to be exactly what I was looking for, but now it's far more than I want or need.

HURTS ME TO SAY THIS. A freaking publicly listed, biggest crypto exchange in the world not only has an app with terrible interface, severe delays, bugs and what not but instead of fixing that, they are obviously now getting into freaking prediction markets. Dude I don't want to get notifications with odds of a college basketball game. Freaking fix your core business of CRYPTO, remember that? thank you for nothing and I absolutely hate this app. Moving from crypto to Kraken or something.

This app is for straight-up gambling degenerates. I downloaded it to show my subscribers how bad it was. They promote a gambling culture, and the majority of people who have Robinhood are here to be wannabe day traders

The latest update completely changed the ui look and feel. its added stupid, unrealised results (which imo is false data that will confuse less educated investors. pretend maybe results, akin to gambling) and there is no option to remove this from the interface. instead, you must toggle between options that were never needed to see the normal breakdown of you current positions units and market value. To see your available cash balance, you have to search around. terrible update
Rode the money wave the first time he was in office...NOW?? Round 2 mfs!!! Robinhood better NOT fail me like the did with the gamestop thing...or I'll cancel again!! #dontplaywithmymoney

Blocked my attempt at making legitimate trades. This has cost me earning opportunity I may never see again. Robinhood has broken it's core promise to it's customers with it's actions. Update: I had hoped I could come back here someday and update my review with a better rating, but now it is just a gambling app and I'm not ok with that. Robinhood is dead.
Used to be decent for quickly monitoring stock prices, but now it's so full of gambling and ads that take forever to scroll past that stocks are basically an afterthought.

This app is the biggest fraud of an app you'll ever find. I opened it to save money and invest in stocks, but these heartless financial types we're not content with their earnings so they added gambling to the app, I never would have gambled if not for this Money grab. If you have an issue with the app there is no one to talk to, only email which is probably AI operated. Do yourself a favor and do not download this app it will save you a lot of money and heartache.
Dont like the new ui change. Probability Market is front and center. I thought Robinhood was a investment app not a gambling app.

super awesome app. b4 coinbase turned themselves into Las Vegas. they should have a separate app. now mine freezes or wheel spinning constantly. moving to another crypto platform that doesn't want to be a gambling hub. I loved coinbase. now its absolutely makes me sick with all the gambling. sad sad sad update: jesus is king!

VERY NASTY AND SNEAKY. Tries to push crypto and event contract features i DO NOT use at the top of main page. no way to reorganize or move to bottom. HAS USELESS deactivated spending account tab without removal possibility after numerous requests. I DO NOT LIKE YOUR SNEAKNIESS.

App works fine for investing BUT they don't stop pushing their built in sports betting service. Just such a scummy and nefarious approach to use on an INVESTMENT app. They want to make it as easy as possible for people to convert their investment account into money in Robinhoods pocket through their new "Combos" and "Predictions." Very thinly veiled sports book and betting service
They've added a Polymarket style prediction market. This used to be a safe and reliable on-ramp, but gambling is a problem for me. I'll have to stop using them.
I don't want to see "prediction markets" (a.k.a. gambling) and there's no way to hide them (only sports can be hidden)

Attempted to remove predictions market and crypto, that constantly junks up my feed. No response from support, so I start the process to move to another brokerage. Suddenly support is trying to fix the issues they created and customer service that was not available when actually needed. Clearly they want to be a gambling site, not a brokerage.

The user interface update is really busy and not very helpful you have to go through three things before you can even see your holdings you have your prediction market which you're pushing down everybody's throats and I even have high prediction market but it still takes up 3 in of the screen you should have an option where you can rearrange everything so when I open up the app I can see my holdings and then I can see what I have in it
gambling on a finance app is awful and predatory. ugly ui

Really needs a way to view % of holdings so you can rebalance your portfolio. Or at least let us export a list of stocks so we can do it in Google sheets or something. Also, the huge push of sports betting and gambling is really annoying and scummy. The only reason I left two stars is because the app is well designed and works for trading stocks well.

AVOID: This was a great app to get an introduction to stock trading and investing. Now it's just an AD for gambling and their premium product. It constantly asks multiple times a day to try gambling and/or upgrade. I've seen more popups for this than actual stock information. Time to move to a different platform.

This company sold out to Wall St. Now it's just a platform designed to lure in young investors to push trash products like prediction market trading and high-risk options trading that they factually know that statistically will financially cripple young new investors.

I dont like their money grabbing futures or what our older generation call scamming your money. Gambling is not investing by any definition. it just proves those who have enough truly want that which others barely survive on.

the casino is a house wins non-stop. the lifting of ptd rules on June 4th 2026 wow. lol to benefit the big institutions. non stop pump and dumps no halts down just up. played with $100 for over a yr .. lift ptd. lost 95% portfolio in 3 days. thanks. will never deposit into the casino market until regulated. taking the last $15 at lightning speed today.. good job.. one thing a actual casino lets ya win once in awhile. so at this point I'd rather play at a casino than stock market that's so sad
redesign sucks hard and makes very little sense. ira should be a separate swipable tab, prediction markets should be a separate tab also.
don't like the forced new layout. wish you could hide the prediction markets. there's the option to hide sports predictions but not the prediction market. or at least change the order....

wish I was able to customize the thr main home screen & remove certain things that I dont use as in predictions and such. the app also doesnt fit the Zfold7 screen aspect ratio folded & unfolded , I've resulted in just using a 4:3 ratio unfolded to fully see the app without things looking funky

1. App main screen is crowded with stuff I don't care about and there's no way to customize. I don't wanna see Prediction markets or Discover more, for example 2. I can't change the main graph to show only stocks, I don't care about how much cash I had last week. Same thing in the website

Time to find a new broker. Robinhood has decided to change from stocks to gambling with prediction market nonsense, and it's dominant on every page, even if you have zero interest in gambling on prediction markets. I came here to invest in stocks, not gamble on sports and politics.

Why are we being forced to look at Crypto and Prediction Market? I find it annoying to have to scroll so far down just to see my positions. I don't care for crypto or Prediction market and I'm tired of robinhood bloating the app with zero way to hide or reduce the clutter

I've been using robinhood for a while.Absolute garbage, you have to press the phone eight times to get options contract. now, they're adding crypto and prediction markets.It's just all too much for 1 app.It's ridiculous
Why are you not issuing warrants on Game Stop? I will be pulling my investment with Robinhood immediately.

There's no reason to show me your prediction markets and meme crypto coins, when I'm just here to invest like a sane person and not to gamble. Having to scroll past irrelevant garbage like that is very annoying. I should be able to select what services I'm interested in, in app settings, and leave it at that.

while the app is amazing and simple for investment they've added prediction market in the app. This is sports betting and I don't want this to show up every time I open the app. I tried disabling it but there is no setting to disable it. I'm gonna move my stocks to some other platform.
Disappointed by the presence of "predictive markets" aka gambling. Really undermines the Robinhood platform for me as a whole, and makes me want to leave
What’s with the constant spacex notifications? It’s very annoying that t212 is continuously trying to push this sketchy IPO on its customers.

App used to work just fine, but now it locks me out asking for a scan of my ID and face. There is no option to refuse. Adding to the gambling scams they've been promoting, I'm ready to transfer to a legitimate institution instead.
I'm leaving robinhood because of the gambling features, I can't take those company seriously managing any money when they are involved in prediction markets AKA GAMBLING
no option to hide the 'prediction market's' section in the app from the home page, it's essentially gambling on everything from elections to the weather, it really cheapens the feel of the app.

simple to use and understand options available for my investment purposes. would absolutely love ability to turn off the prediction market stuff but I get that is their bread and butter, making money off people gambling away their future. can't beat the match on deposits and IRA match with gold membership. they're paying me to use their platform.

Robinhood revolutionized the industry when it first came out and was a masterclass in a great mobile experience. Those days are over. Too cluttered, lack of visual separation and color identifiers, too pushy for the Gold subscription service and use of additional high-risk services (e.g. crypto, prediction markets), even if you don't want to use them. Way too much for traditional investors. They don't care about the users anymore. Use Fidelity instead.
this app UX is awful... stop trying to make it look like a casino, I just want to manage my investments

Edit: Prediction markets can only be removed by reaching RH customer support and specifically requesting it, no backsies. Needs an option to hide the prediction market or anything not relevant to the individual user. This strikes me as an intentional design choice that benefits RH but not the end user. Encourages gambling, not investing. Stick to your roots RH...this BS is not cool

Essentially gamified garbage designed to keep you clicking, while adding zero value to your investment decisions. If you want to make social media posts and have randomers waving their 'pie' in your face screaming to copy them, this is the place for you. If you want useful information from an investment perspective look elsewhere.

They're pushing predictions markets hard. its crazy how they place the betting section before I can get to see my holdings as I scroll down the app. promoting gambling instead of investing doesnt sit well with me.
It's a gambling app, stay away. When it first started it was good because it was just no fee stocks, but now it's a gambling app with shady practices.

Integrating sports bets into the same chart as investments is misleading and unethical. It blurs the line between investing and gambling, gamifies losses, and pressures users to chase them. Betting on a Sunday game should never be treated the same as long-term investing, this design choice feels intentional and predatory. I will be switching platforms
Give us an option to remove crypto, prediction markets, and other bs from the homepage! Not all of us want to throw their money away!

the app tends to make some features I am looking for difficult to find and I dont even know if you can customize your main screen, but I would love to filter out anything relating to prediction markets, yet it is crammed right in there in my way every time. the app was good at offering a free investing platform but now they go out of their way to push things upon you that you dont want.
trying to shove sports betting down my throat with no notification category to turn them off.

Not impressed with your move into gambling aka "events contracts." But whatever. I'm a little older than your demographic, so I can't imagine my opinion matters much. I guess now that the heat is off you can bring back the confetti emoji. But, the app has gotten really frustrating lately. I regularly restart my phone to make sure it's not me.

Is it possible to fix the UI so the user has more control over what they see first? I'm constantly bombarded with prediction market options first in the landing area and always need to scroll down to see my investments. It's not positive marketing, it's annoying. This after user PII was leaked and users have to ensure not to be scammed by constant phishing emails and texts. I'm going to be moving all assets off this platform soon. Poor integration and security measures. RH lacks responsibility.

move the prediction markets out of the way of my actual investments. I DO NOT CARE TO GAMBLE ON "WHO WILL TAKE OVER WARNER BROTHERS" OR "WHICH FOOTBALL COACH WILL BE OUT BEFORE SEPTEMBER" there are plenty of investment apps. maybe I'll just go back to tastytrade

Garbage junk sports prediction markets ruined Robinhood. It literally clogs up the screen. They placed that junk above my investments trying to jam force it on me against my will. I will NEVER use prediction markets. Even the option to hide them doesn't work and they insist on taking up half your home screen. I'm closing my account and moving to a different platform. Robinhood is a shady company.
with the addition of prediction markets this investment app becomes a gambling app and you cant remove it from the home page so im switching to another service provider for investments

Gambling? I'm not putting any more money into a platform that doesn't actually hold the crypto they sell when that same platform is also being used for sports gambling. Might as well rename it "Bookie"

Robin hood wallet has been a huge rip off can't get money out it's a trap im gonna have to sue them.. robinhood is trash too they started stealing money like a casino on their prediction markets your retirement is not safe here!
Only not 5/5 because the app is very insistent on keeping crypto and prediction market slop very visible when I'd rather never see it.
used to be better, but with all the prediction market gambling and changes to accounts, I'm taking my money elsewhere.

Pseudo-gambling and crypto have driven me elsewhere, but what's caused me to write this review is just how difficult closing my account is. Multiple issues with actually getting the app to register I have done everything required to close the account, the app has begun to log me out regularly. This service was a decent idea turned "how can we extract more money" as soon as the initial wave ended. At least big brokers take things seriously.
App is getting more laggy, interface is getting worse and the whole platform is turning into an online casino.
I've been using Robinhood for years, but will be cancelling my subscription and deleting the app due to their addition of sports betting. It's too tempting. I'll stick to Fidelity.

The app was great until they added all the sports betting and gambling. It's very obtrusive and I hate that I have to keep tapping the X's to dismiss all the gambling pop-ups. I'm looking into another wallet that isn't so gambling focused now :/

Predictions is very troublesome to navigate, some positions that lethalshot holds cant be found, what event is that recurring buys are hard to cancel, no quick entry to manage them which is weird as a kind

Poor user interface. I don't know what they did but it used to be a great platform for trading they changed the whole interface so now it looks like you're playing a video game and you do not have all the information on the screen like you used to with charts, bids, asks and your portfolio . This app has turned into a little kids toy used to lure people in to legal gambling. Disgusting. Go with a professional app if you're an adult trader.
adding sports betting to an "investment" app is disgusting.
This is a gambling app. Its pretty disgusting what they have done. Ads and gambling and they call it an investing platform... use Fidelity.
app has become a gambling app for young adults trying to invest in their future. scummy company doing scummy things.
